source_provenance: Exterior, interior, astronaut, title, and first-person stills captured from final visual source equivalent to revision 3b03ac4fde9b26369bdfe62e4251776d7682b8f5. Subsequent release commits add generated UIDs and nonvisual naming/documentation changes. Portrait and walkthrough were captured with release commit 1b4d1b8e0907f76a055a8aca85e1073c4eff34eb checked out. These are source-project renders, not captures of a downloaded signed installer.
renderer: Linux X11, authenticated Xvfb, Mesa llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, 256 bits)

stills.gameplay: Normal game.begin() at default player spawn; camera and HUD unchanged.
stills.portrait: 390x844 desktop viewport through normal game.begin(); this is a layout capture, not physical mobile-device validation. The camera-mounted instrument is partly clipped at narrow aspect.

walkthrough.capture: Godot --write-movie with --fixed-fps 12; movie output 1280x720. GIF resized to 960x540 with Lanczos filtering and palette encoding.
walkthrough.input_sequence: Normal game.begin(); W held for 36 frames; 12 ordinary mouse-motion events turning right; Q key toggles visor cleaning; W held for 24 frames; release and hold view for 12 frames.
walkthrough.timing: Fixed-timestep movie capture preserves simulation/input progression. It does not represent realtime rendering performance. Startup trimmed by 0.75 seconds.
walkthrough.encoding: 10 fps, 96-color palette, Bayer dithering, looping GIF, no audio.
walkthrough.driver_gdscript:
extends SceneTree
## Review-only movie driver. Uses ordinary physical key/mouse input; no simulation edits.
func _initialize(): call_deferred("capture")
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool):
	var event=InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode=code
	event.physical_keycode=code
	event.pressed=pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)
func frames(count: int):
	for i in range(count): await process_frame
func capture():
	root.size=Vector2i(960,540)
	var game=load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(game)
	await frames(3)
	game.begin()
	await frames(6)
	key(KEY_W,true)
	await frames(36)
	key(KEY_W,false)
	for i in range(12):
		var event=InputEventMouseMotion.new()
		event.relative=Vector2(12,0)
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		await process_frame
	key(KEY_Q,true)
	await frames(1)
	key(KEY_Q,false)
	key(KEY_W,true)
	await frames(24)
	key(KEY_W,false)
	await frames(12)
	quit()
walkthrough.state_changes: No teleport, mission-state editing, fabricated telemetry, composited features, or generated gameplay imagery.
